steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: AQA 8236 requires students to study specific set professional works for the written exam | Key Fact: The set professional works are 'Within Her Eyes' by James Cousins, 'Artificial Things' by Lucy Bennett and 'Emancipation of Expressionism' by Kenrick H2O Sandy | Key Fact: Each work has a distinct choreographic intention, style and set of features that must be understood in detail | Key Fact: Professional works are assessed in Section C of the written exam, worth 25 marks

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from professional dance works overview, and one past-paper question.
